notes: Published title 'Pods  Profit  and @#$%es' is a masked crude word, so the page is titled by player and side (Jason Keen LS); the published title stays in the source citation.

Starting cards as described in the strategy: Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Han Solo and the Objective, show the podracer (Podrace Prep is the only starting interrupt in the list), and 'in most cases' Goo Nee Tay; all count toward the 60 (total 60).

Posted 'You can either Profit by this . . .' dested the Objective You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed; 'Palace AC' dested Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber; 'Tatooine Palace' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Tatooine Cantina' dested Tatooine: Cantina (Light); 'Tatooine Arena' dested Tatooine: Podrace Arena; 'Tatooine Outskirts' dested Tatooine: City Outskirts.

Joke names: 'Lando w/ Colt 45 Malt Liquor' dested Lando With Blaster Pistol; 'Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight and friend of Captain Solo' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Massa Luke' dested Master Luke; 'Qui-Gon Keen' dested Qui-Gon Jinn; 'Leia w/ Blasta' dested Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Han w/ Pistol' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; '3P0 in the Nude' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'Anakin Skywalker's Ford POS' dested Anakin's Podracer.

Posted 'My Stick' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber because the author's handle is Qui (he signs 'Qui-Gon Keen') and the deck runs Qui-Gon Jinn; 'Ben's Stick' dested Obi-Wan's Lightsaber; 'Luke's Stick' dested Luke's Lightsaber.

Posted 'Goo Nee Gay' dested Goo Nee Tay; 'Da' Camp' dested The Camp; 'DODN&WA' dested Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice; 'Honor of da Jedi' dested Honor Of The Jedi; Weapon Levitation dested the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt; 'OOC & TT' and 'Shocking Info & Grimtaash' dested the combo interrupts.
Author claims a 17-3 sanctioned record in June 2001 tournaments (losses to John Arendt twice and Brian Hunter) and a win over Brian Hunter; no named event.
Format Premiere - Tatooine: July 2001 post, no Coruscant cards.
